title: 第九章 你们盐吃多了第十章 舆论
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
联邦军校——自联邦建立以来的第一军校，期间为联邦军部输出了数不胜数的优秀人才。
校内指挥系、战斗系与机甲工程系，并称三大王牌专业，每年从这三个专业毕业的应届生都是各大军团、商部的争抢对象。
按理来说，这种王牌专业是不会接受插班生的，更何况这个插班生还是从艺术专业转来的。
但谁让人家有个好爸爸呢？
唐渊给学校捐赠了一大笔星币，只为给女儿买一个测试名额，如果测试不通过，校方不仅可以拒绝唐斩月的转专业申请，还能白赚一大笔星币……
咳咳，面对如此感天动地的父爱，校方怎么忍心拒绝？
下午一点三十分，一黑色悬浮车停在联邦军校门口，引来路过学生的瞩目。
无他，只因这款悬浮车是t集团的最新款，前两天刚上市，搭载最新一代的自动驾驶和自救系统。
功能让人心动，但价格贵到离谱。
当时，全网都在猜这车的受众到底在哪儿，没想到这么快他们就见到了实物，也因此对车主非常好奇。
万众瞩目下，悬浮车的车门被推开，修长的小腿包裹在利落的工装裤内，踩着短款战靴落在地上。
随后，高挑靓丽的身影出现在众人眼前，众人都愣住了。
直到那道人影消失在校门口，才有人不敢置信地惊呼出声：“唐斩月？！”
不都说她是唐家的穷亲戚吗？谁家穷亲戚开这么豪的车啊！
“嗐，说不定是偷偷开了晚意小姐的车出来装呢，她不一直这样吗？”
周围的人被说服了，纷纷鄙夷地撇嘴，甚至还有人偷偷给悬浮车拍照，发给了温晚意，说唐斩月偷开她的车。
温晚意正在同学的簇拥下从食堂出来，在看到消息的瞬间，脸上原本温柔的笑意便退个干干净净，面色也白了两分。
“晚意你怎么了？是不是身体不舒服？”
温晚意牵强地扯了扯唇角，“抱歉，我有事要先走，下次再聊。”
她转身疾步离开，先给那位同学发消息道谢，顺便问了唐斩月的去向，然后立马给贺兰逸打去电话。

“逸哥哥。”温晚意嗓音颤抖，“唐斩月来学校了，还开了一辆豪车，她这么高调，一定是来报复我的，逸哥哥……我好害怕。”
“别怕，我现在过去找你。”贺兰逸急匆匆地跑起来，“你放心，我不会让唐斩月贸然公开身份的。”
温晚意顿了下，轻声回应：“好。”
她挂断通讯，眼底的神色狰狞扭曲，不贸然公开？意思就是早晚会公开！
为什么？为什么不能维持现状！唐斩月为什么不能一直软弱下去！
还有贺兰逸，说什么会保护她！到最后还不是要让她失去现在的一切！甚至要面对众人的嘲笑，指责……
不行，她绝不能让这件事发生！
叮的一声，那位通风报信的同学再次发来消息：唐斩月去了机甲工程系。
……
机甲工程系的教室跟传统教室不一样，很高很大，像工厂仓库，教室后面整齐停放着一排排的教学用机甲，中间一个巨大的圆台，是老师上课的地方。
圆台上方还有360度的光屏展示，确保学生无论在教室的哪个位置都能清楚地看到老师的操作与讲解。
content_en:
The Federal Military Academy is the first military academy since the establishment of the Federation. During this period, it has exported countless outstanding talents to the Federal Military Department.
The Command Department, Combat Department and Mecha Engineering Department on campus are also known as the three major majors. Every year, fresh graduates from these three majors are the targets of competition for major military corps and commercial departments.
Logically speaking, such a trump card major would not accept transfer students, not to mention that this transfer student was transferred from the art major.
But who wants someone to have a good father?
Tang Yuan donated a large amount of star coins to the school just to buy a test spot for his daughter. If he failed the test, the school could not only reject Tang Zhanyue's application for changing majors, but also earn a large amount of star coins in vain...
Ahem, how could the school have the heart to refuse such a father's love that is so touching?
At 1:30 in the afternoon, a black hover car parked in front of the Federal Military Academy, attracting the attention of passing students.
Nothing else, just because this suspension car is the latest model of the T Group. It was just launched two days ago and is equipped with the latest generation of automatic driving and self-rescue systems.
The features are exciting, but the price is ridiculously expensive.
At that time, the entire Internet was guessing where the audience for this car was. Unexpectedly, they saw the real thing so soon, and they were very curious about the owner of the car.
Under the spotlight, the door of the hover car was pushed open, and his slender calves were wrapped in neat overalls, and he landed on the ground wearing short combat boots.
Then, a tall and beautiful figure appeared in front of everyone, and everyone was stunned.
It wasn't until the figure disappeared at the school gate that someone exclaimed in disbelief: "Tang Zhanyue?!"
Don't they all say that she is a poor relative of the Tang family? Whose poor relative drives such a luxurious car?
"Hey, maybe he secretly drove Miss Wanyi's car to pretend. Isn't she always like this?"
The people around them were convinced and pouted with disdain. Some even secretly took photos of the hover car and sent them to Wen Wanyi, saying that Tang Zhanyue stole her car.
Wen Wanyi came out of the cafeteria surrounded by her classmates. The moment she saw the news, the gentle smile on her face completely faded away, and her complexion turned two points white.
"What's wrong with you, Wanyi? Are you feeling unwell?"
Wen Wanyi twitched the corners of her lips forcefully, "Sorry, I have something to do and I have to leave first. Let's talk next time."
She turned around and left quickly. She first sent a message to the classmate to thank her, asked about Tang Zhanyue's whereabouts, and then immediately called He Lanyi.
"Brother Yi." Wen Wanyi's voice trembled, "Tang Zhanyue came to school and drove a luxury car. She is so high-profile. She must be here to take revenge on me. Brother Yi... I'm so scared."
"Don't be afraid, I'll go find you now." He Lanyi hurriedly ran, "Don't worry, I won't let Tang Zhanyue reveal his identity rashly."
Wen Wanyi paused and responded softly: "Okay."
She hung up the call, the look in her eyes was ferocious and twisted, why not make it public rashly? It means it will be made public sooner or later!
Why? Why can't we maintain the status quo! Why can't Tang Zhanyue continue to be weak!
And He Lanyi, how could he protect her? In the end, we don’t want her to lose everything she has now! He even had to face the ridicule and accusations from everyone...
No, she can't let this happen!
With a ding, the classmate who tipped off the news sent another message: Tang Zhanyue went to the Mecha Engineering Department.
…
The classrooms in the Mecha Engineering Department are different from traditional classrooms. They are very tall and large, like factory warehouses. Rows of teaching mechas are neatly parked behind the classroom, and a huge round platform in the middle is where teachers hold classes.
There is also a 360-degree light screen display above the round platform to ensure that students can clearly see the teacher's operations and explanations no matter where they are in the classroom.
